title: Granulon: Awakening Pixel-Level Visual Encoders with Adaptive Multi-Granularity Semantics for MLLM
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models largely rely on CLIP-based visual encoders, which emphasize global semantic alignment but struggle with fine-grained visual understanding. In contrast, DINOv3 provides strong pixel-level perception yet lacks coarse-grained semantic abstraction, leading to limited multi-granularity reasoning. To address this gap, we propose Granulon, a novel DINOv3-based MLLM with adaptive granularity augmentation. Granulon introduces a text-conditioned granularity Controller that dynamically adjusts the visual abstraction level according to the semantic scope of the textual input, and an Adaptive Token Aggregation module that performs granularity-guided pooling and relation-aware clustering to produce compact, semantically rich visual tokens. This design enables unified "pixel-to-fine-to-coarse" reasoning within a single forward pass. Extensive and interpretable experiments demonstrate that Granulon improves accuracy by ~30% and reduces hallucination by ~20%, outperforming all visual encoders under identical settings.

AI.tldr: 提出Granulon模型，基于DINOv3的多模态大语言模型，通过自适应粒度增强解决现有视觉编码器在细粒度理解和多粒度推理方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP视觉编码器强调全局语义对齐但缺乏细粒度视觉理解，而DINOv3提供像素级感知但缺乏粗粒度语义抽象，导致多粒度推理能力有限。
AI.method: 提出文本条件粒度控制器动态调整视觉抽象级别，以及自适应令牌聚合模块执行粒度引导池化和关系感知聚类，生成紧凑且语义丰富的视觉令牌，实现单次前向传播中的统一"像素到细粒度到粗粒度"推理。
AI.result: 实验表明Granulon在相同设置下优于所有视觉编码器，准确率提高约30%，幻觉减少约20%。
AI.conclusion: Granulon通过自适应粒度增强有效解决了多模态大语言模型中视觉编码器的多粒度推理问题，在准确性和减少幻觉方面取得显著改进。

title: Where, What, Why: Toward Explainable 3D-GS Watermarking
summary: As 3D Gaussian Splatting becomes the de facto representation for interactive 3D assets, robust yet imperceptible watermarking is critical. We present a representation-native framework that separates where to write from how to preserve quality. A Trio-Experts module operates directly on Gaussian primitives to derive priors for carrier selection, while a Safety and Budget Aware Gate (SBAG) allocates Gaussians to watermark carriers, optimized for bit resilience under perturbation and bitrate budgets, and to visual compensators that are insulated from watermark loss. To maintain fidelity, we introduce a channel-wise group mask that controls gradient propagation for carriers and compensators, thereby limiting Gaussian parameter updates, repairing local artifacts, and preserving high-frequency details without increasing runtime. Our design yields view-consistent watermark persistence and strong robustness against common image distortions such as compression and noise, while achieving a favorable robustness-quality trade-off compared with prior methods. In addition, decoupled finetuning provides per-Gaussian attributions that reveal where the message is carried and why those carriers are selected, enabling auditable explainability. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, our approach achieves a PSNR improvement of +0.83 dB and a bit-accuracy gain of +1.24%.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对3D高斯泼溅表示的鲁棒且不可感知的水印框架，通过专家模块选择载体，门控机制分配资源，通道分组掩码保持质量，实现视图一致的水印持久性和强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着3D高斯泼溅成为交互式3D资产的事实标准表示方法，需要开发鲁棒且不可感知的水印技术来保护这些资产。
AI.method: 提出表示原生框架，包含Trio-Experts模块直接操作高斯基元获取载体选择先验，Safety and Budget Aware Gate分配高斯基元到水印载体和视觉补偿器，通道分组掩码控制梯度传播以保持质量。
AI.result: 相比现有方法，PSNR提升+0.83 dB，比特准确率提升+1.24%，实现视图一致的水印持久性，对压缩和噪声等常见图像失真具有强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在3D高斯泼溅表示中实现了鲁棒且不可感知的水印，通过解耦微调提供可审计的解释性，展示了优越的鲁棒性-质量权衡。

title: VisionCreator-R1: A Reflection-Enhanced Native Visual-Generation Agentic Model
summary: Visual content generation has advanced from single-image to multi-image workflows, yet existing agents remain largely plan-driven and lack systematic reflection mechanisms to correct mid-trajectory visual errors. To address this limitation, we propose VisionCreator-R1, a native visual generation agent with explicit reflection, together with a Reflection-Plan Co-Optimization (RPCO) training methodology. Through extensive experiments and trajectory-level analysis, we uncover reflection-plan optimization asymmetry in reinforcement learning (RL): planning can be reliably optimized via plan rewards, while reflection learning is hindered by noisy credit assignment. Guided by this insight, our RPCO first trains on the self-constructed VCR-SFT dataset with reflection-strong single-image trajectories and planning-strong multi-image trajectories, then co-optimization on VCR-RL dataset via RL. This yields our unified VisionCreator-R1 agent, which consistently outperforms Gemini2.5Pro on existing benchmarks and our VCR-bench covering single-image and multi-image tasks.

AI.tldr: VisionCreator-R1：具有显式反思机制的原生视觉生成代理，通过反思-规划协同优化训练方法，在单图像和多图像任务上超越现有模型
AI.motivation: 现有视觉生成代理主要基于规划驱动，缺乏系统性反思机制来纠正生成过程中的视觉错误，限制了多图像工作流程的质量和可靠性
AI.method: 提出VisionCreator-R1原生视觉生成代理，采用反思-规划协同优化训练方法：1）在自建的VCR-SFT数据集上训练，包含反思强的单图像轨迹和规划强的多图像轨迹；2）在VCR-RL数据集上通过强化学习进行协同优化
AI.result: VisionCreator-R1在现有基准测试和自建的VCR-bench上一致超越Gemini2.5Pro，涵盖单图像和多图像任务；通过轨迹级分析揭示了强化学习中反思-规划优化的不对称性
AI.conclusion: 显式反思机制和反思-规划协同优化方法能有效提升视觉生成代理的性能，解决了规划可优化而反思学习受噪声信用分配阻碍的问题，为视觉内容生成提供了新的解决方案

title: One Language, Two Scripts: Probing Script-Invariance in LLM Concept Representations
comment: Accepted at the UCRL Workshop at ICLR 2026
summary: Do the features learned by Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) represent abstract meaning, or are they tied to how text is written? We investigate this question using Serbian digraphia as a controlled testbed: Serbian is written interchangeably in Latin and Cyrillic scripts with a near-perfect character mapping between them, enabling us to vary orthography while holding meaning exactly constant. Crucially, these scripts are tokenized completely differently, sharing no tokens whatsoever. Analyzing SAE feature activations across the Gemma model family (270M-27B parameters), we find that identical sentences in different Serbian scripts activate highly overlapping features, far exceeding random baselines. Strikingly, changing script causes less representational divergence than paraphrasing within the same script, suggesting SAE features prioritize meaning over orthographic form. Cross-script cross-paraphrase comparisons provide evidence against memorization, as these combinations rarely co-occur in training data yet still exhibit substantial feature overlap. This script invariance strengthens with model scale. Taken together, our findings suggest that SAE features can capture semantics at a level of abstraction above surface tokenization, and we propose Serbian digraphia as a general evaluation paradigm for probing the abstractness of learned representations.

AI.tldr: 研究发现稀疏自编码器（SAE）学习的特征更关注语义而非拼写形式，通过塞尔维亚语的双文种（拉丁和西里尔字母）实验证明，即使完全不同的分词方式，相同含义的句子仍能激活高度重叠的特征。
AI.motivation: 探究稀疏自编码器（SAE）学习的特征是否代表抽象语义，还是与文本书写形式（拼写）相关。利用塞尔维亚语双文种（拉丁和西里尔字母）作为受控测试平台，因为这两种文字有近乎完美的字符映射，可以改变正字法同时保持语义完全不变。
AI.method: 使用塞尔维亚语双文种（拉丁和西里尔字母）作为实验平台，这两种文字有完全不同的分词方式（不共享任何token）。分析Gemma模型家族（270M-27B参数）中SAE特征激活，比较相同句子在不同文字中的特征重叠度，并与随机基线、同文字内的转述进行比较。
AI.result: 1. 不同文字中的相同句子激活高度重叠的特征，远超随机基线；2. 改变文字导致的表征差异小于同文字内的转述差异，表明SAE特征更关注语义而非拼写形式；3. 跨文字跨转述比较排除了记忆效应；4. 这种文字不变性随模型规模增强。
AI.conclusion: SAE特征能够在表面分词之上捕捉抽象语义，塞尔维亚语双文种可作为评估学习表征抽象性的通用范式。特征优先考虑语义而非正字法形式，且这种抽象能力随模型规模提升。

title: MASEval: Extending Multi-Agent Evaluation from Models to Systems
summary:
The rapid adoption of LLM-based agentic systems has produced a rich ecosystem of frameworks (smolagents, LangGraph, AutoGen, CAMEL, LlamaIndex, i.a.). Yet existing benchmarks are model-centric: they fix the agentic setup and do not compare other system components. We argue that implementation decisions substantially impact performance, including choices such as topology, orchestration logic, and error handling. MASEval addresses this evaluation gap with a framework-agnostic library that treats the entire system as the unit of analysis. Through a systematic system-level comparison across 3 benchmarks, 3 models, and 3 frameworks, we find that framework choice matters as much as model choice. MASEval allows researchers to explore all components of agentic systems, opening new avenues for principled system design, and practitioners to identify the best implementation for their use case.
  MASEval is available under the MIT licence https://github.com/parameterlab/MASEval.

AI.tldr: MASEval是一个框架无关的评估库，专注于LLM智能体系统的系统级评估，发现框架选择对性能的影响与模型选择同样重要。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要是模型中心的，固定智能体设置而不比较其他系统组件。作者认为实现决策（如拓扑结构、编排逻辑、错误处理）会显著影响性能，但缺乏相应的评估方法。
AI.method: 开发了MASEval框架无关的评估库，将整个系统作为分析单元。通过系统级的比较实验，涵盖3个基准测试、3个模型和3个框架，评估不同组件对性能的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现框架选择对性能的影响与模型选择同样重要。MASEval能够帮助研究人员探索智能体系统的所有组件，为系统设计提供新途径，并帮助实践者为特定用例选择最佳实现。
AI.conclusion: MASEval填补了智能体系统评估的空白，提供了框架无关的系统级评估方法，揭示了实现决策对性能的重要影响，为智能体系统的设计和优化提供了新工具。

title: A Lightweight Multi-Cancer Tumor Localization Framework for Deployable Digital Pathology
summary: Accurate localization of tumor regions from hematoxylin and eosin-stained whole-slide images is fundamental for translational research including spatial analysis, molecular profiling, and tissue architecture investigation. However, deep learning-based tumor detection trained within specific cancers may exhibit reduced robustness when applied across different tumor types. We investigated whether balanced training across cancers at modest scale can achieve high performance and generalize to unseen tumor types. A multi-cancer tumor localization model (MuCTaL) was trained on 79,984 non-overlapping tiles from four cancers (melanoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, colorectal cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer) using transfer learning with DenseNet169. The model achieved a tile-level ROC-AUC of 0.97 in validation data from the four training cancers, and 0.71 on an independent pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cohort. A scalable inference workflow was built to generate spatial tumor probability heatmaps compatible with existing digital pathology tools. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/AivaraX-AI/MuCTaL.

AI.tldr: 开发了一个多癌症肿瘤定位模型MuCTaL，通过平衡训练四种癌症数据，实现了高精度肿瘤定位，并能泛化到未见过的癌症类型。
AI.motivation: 基于深度学习的肿瘤检测方法在特定癌症上训练后，应用于不同肿瘤类型时可能缺乏鲁棒性。研究探索是否通过适度规模的跨癌症平衡训练，能够实现高性能并泛化到未见过的肿瘤类型。
AI.method: 使用迁移学习和DenseNet169架构，在四种癌症（黑色素瘤、肝细胞癌、结直肠癌和非小细胞肺癌）的79,984个非重叠图像块上进行训练，构建多癌症肿瘤定位模型MuCTaL，并开发可扩展的推理工作流程生成空间肿瘤概率热图。
AI.result: 在训练癌症验证数据上达到0.97的ROC-AUC，在独立胰腺导管腺癌队列上达到0.71的ROC-AUC，表明模型具有良好的泛化能力。开发了与现有数字病理工具兼容的空间肿瘤概率热图生成工作流程。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨癌症平衡训练，即使规模不大也能实现高性能的肿瘤定位，并能泛化到未见过的癌症类型。模型和代码已公开，为空间分析、分子分析和组织架构研究提供了实用工具。

title: LDP: An Identity-Aware Protocol for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: As multi-agent AI systems grow in complexity, the protocols connecting them constrain their capabilities. Current protocols such as A2A and MCP do not expose model-level properties as first-class primitives, ignoring properties fundamental to effective delegation: model identity, reasoning profile, quality calibration, and cost characteristics. We present the LLM Delegate Protocol (LDP), an AI-native communication protocol introducing five mechanisms: (1) rich delegate identity cards with quality hints and reasoning profiles; (2) progressive payload modes with negotiation and fallback; (3) governed sessions with persistent context; (4) structured provenance tracking confidence and verification status; (5) trust domains enforcing security boundaries at the protocol level. We implement LDP as a plugin for the JamJet agent runtime and evaluate against A2A and random baselines using local Ollama models and LLM-as-judge evaluation. Identity-aware routing achieves ~12x lower latency on easy tasks through delegate specialization, though it does not improve aggregate quality in our small delegate pool; semantic frame payloads reduce token count by 37% (p=0.031) with no observed quality loss; governed sessions eliminate 39% token overhead at 10 rounds; and noisy provenance degrades synthesis quality below the no-provenance baseline, arguing that confidence metadata is harmful without verification. Simulated analyses show architectural advantages in attack detection (96% vs. 6%) and failure recovery (100% vs. 35% completion). This paper contributes a protocol design, reference implementation, and initial evidence that AI-native protocol primitives enable more efficient and governable delegation.

AI.tldr: LLM Delegate Protocol (LDP) 是一种AI原生通信协议，通过引入五种机制改进多智能体系统间的通信效率与治理能力，相比现有协议在延迟、token使用和安全性方面有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 当前多智能体AI系统的通信协议（如A2A和MCP）未能将模型级属性作为一等公民，忽略了有效委托所需的基本属性：模型身份、推理配置文件、质量校准和成本特征，这限制了系统的能力。
AI.method: 提出了LLM Delegate Protocol (LDP)，包含五种核心机制：1）带有质量提示和推理配置文件的丰富委托身份卡；2）具有协商和回退功能的渐进式负载模式；3）具有持久上下文的治理会话；4）跟踪置信度和验证状态的结构化溯源；5）在协议级别强制执行安全边界的信任域。在JamJet代理运行时中实现LDP插件，使用本地Ollama模型和LLM-as-judge评估方法对比A2A和随机基线。
AI.result: 身份感知路由在简单任务上实现约12倍延迟降低（通过委托专业化）；语义帧负载减少37%的token使用（p=0.031）且无质量损失；治理会话在10轮对话中消除39%的token开销；噪声溯源会降低合成质量，表明无验证的置信度元数据有害。模拟分析显示在攻击检测（96% vs. 6%）和故障恢复（100% vs. 35%完成率）方面具有架构优势。
AI.conclusion: LLM Delegate Protocol通过AI原生协议原语实现了更高效和可治理的委托，为多智能体系统通信提供了新的协议设计、参考实现和初步证据，展示了在延迟、资源使用和安全性方面的显著改进。

title: HECTOR: Hybrid Editable Compositional Object References for Video Generation
summary: Real-world videos naturally portray complex interactions among distinct physical objects, effectively forming dynamic compositions of visual elements. However, most current video generation models synthesize scenes holistically and therefore lack mechanisms for explicit compositional manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose HECTOR, a generative pipeline that enables fine-grained compositional control. In contrast to prior methods,HECTOR supports hybrid reference conditioning, allowing generation to be simultaneously guided by static images and/or dynamic videos. Moreover, users can explicitly specify the trajectory of each referenced element, precisely controlling its location, scale, and speed (see Figure1). This design allows the model to synthesize coherent videos that satisfy complex spatiotemporal constraints while preserving high-fidelity adherence to references. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HECTOR achieves superior visual quality, stronger reference preservation, and improved motion controllability compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: HECTOR是一个支持细粒度组合控制的视频生成管道，允许通过静态图像和/或动态视频进行混合参考条件化，并能显式指定每个参考元素的轨迹，精确控制其位置、尺寸和速度。
AI.motivation: 现实世界视频自然描绘了不同物理对象之间的复杂交互，形成了视觉元素的动态组合。然而，当前大多数视频生成模型整体合成场景，缺乏显式组合操作的机制。
AI.method: 提出HECTOR生成管道，支持混合参考条件化（静态图像和/或动态视频），用户可以显式指定每个参考元素的轨迹，精确控制其位置、尺寸和速度，从而合成满足复杂时空约束的连贯视频。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HECTOR相比现有方法实现了更优的视觉质量、更强的参考保持能力和改进的运动可控性。
AI.conclusion: HECTOR通过细粒度组合控制机制解决了当前视频生成模型缺乏显式组合操作的问题，为复杂交互场景的视频合成提供了更精确的控制能力。

title: ConFu: Contemplate the Future for Better Speculative Sampling
comment: accepted at ICLR 2026 workshop on Latent & Implicit Thinking - Going Beyond CoT Reasoning
summary: Speculative decoding has emerged as a powerful approach to accelerate large language model (LLM) inference by employing lightweight draft models to propose candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. The effectiveness of this paradigm critically depends on the quality of the draft model. While recent advances such as the EAGLE series achieve state-of-the-art speedup, existing draft models remain limited by error accumulation: they condition only on the current prefix, causing their predictions to drift from the target model over steps. In this work, we propose \textbf{ConFu} (Contemplate the Future), a novel speculative decoding framework that enables draft models to anticipate the future direction of generation. ConFu introduces (i) contemplate tokens and soft prompts that allow the draft model to leverage future-oriented signals from the target model at negligible cost, (ii) a dynamic contemplate token mechanism with MoE to enable context-aware future prediction, and (iii) a training framework with anchor token sampling and future prediction replication that learns robust future prediction. Experiments demonstrate that ConFu improves token acceptance rates and generation speed over EAGLE-3 by 8--11% across various downstream tasks with Llama-3 3B and 8B models. We believe our work is the first to bridge speculative decoding with continuous reasoning tokens, offering a new direction for accelerating LLM inference.

AI.tldr: ConFu是一种新颖的推测解码框架，通过让草稿模型预测生成未来方向来提高LLM推理速度，相比EAGLE-3提升了8-11%的token接受率和生成速度。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码方法中的草稿模型仅基于当前前缀进行预测，容易产生错误累积，导致预测逐渐偏离目标模型。需要让草稿模型能够预测生成过程的未来方向。
AI.method: 提出ConFu框架：1) 引入思考token和软提示，让草稿模型以极低成本利用目标模型的未来导向信号；2) 动态思考token机制配合MoE实现上下文感知的未来预测；3) 包含锚点token采样和未来预测复制的训练框架，学习鲁棒的未来预测能力。
AI.result: 在Llama-3 3B和8B模型的各种下游任务中，ConFu相比EAGLE-3提升了8-11%的token接受率和生成速度。
AI.conclusion: ConFu首次将推测解码与连续推理token相结合，为加速LLM推理提供了新方向，通过让草稿模型预测未来方向显著提升了推测解码的效果。

title: Quantifying the Accuracy and Cost Impact of Design Decisions in Budget-Constrained Agentic LLM Search
comment: Accepted in 2026 Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC)
summary: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems combine iterative search, planning prompts, and retrieval backends, but deployed settings impose explicit budgets on tool calls and completion tokens. We present a controlled measurement study of how search depth, retrieval strategy, and completion budget affect accuracy and cost under fixed constraints. Using Budget-Constrained Agentic Search (BCAS), a model-agnostic evaluation harness that surfaces remaining budget and gates tool use, we run comparisons across six LLMs and three question-answering benchmarks. Across models and datasets, accuracy improves with additional searches up to a small cap, hybrid lexical and dense retrieval with lightweight re-ranking produces the largest average gains in our ablation grid, and larger completion budgets are most helpful on HotpotQA-style synthesis. These results provide practical guidance for configuring budgeted agentic retrieval pipelines and are accompanied by reproducible prompts and evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了预算约束下的智能RAG系统，通过BCAS评估框架分析了搜索深度、检索策略和完成预算对准确性和成本的影响，为配置预算受限的智能检索管道提供实用指导。
AI.motivation: 智能检索增强生成系统结合了迭代搜索、规划提示和检索后端，但在实际部署中面临工具调用和完成token的明确预算限制。需要研究如何在固定约束下优化系统性能。
AI.method: 提出Budget-Constrained Agentic Search评估框架，该框架与模型无关，能够显示剩余预算并控制工具使用。在6个LLM和3个问答基准上进行比较，分析搜索深度、检索策略和完成预算的影响。
AI.result: 准确率随搜索次数增加而提高，但存在较小上限；混合词汇和密集检索配合轻量级重排序带来最大平均增益；更大的完成预算在HotpotQA式合成任务中最有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为配置预算受限的智能检索管道提供了实用指导，并提供了可复现的提示和评估设置，帮助在实际部署中平衡准确性和成本。

title: SciTaRC: Benchmarking QA on Scientific Tabular Data that Requires Language Reasoning and Complex Computation
summary: We introduce SciTaRC, an expert-authored benchmark of questions about tabular data in scientific papers requiring both deep language reasoning and complex computation. We show that current state-of-the-art AI models fail on at least 23% of these questions, a gap that remains significant even for highly capable open-weight models like Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, which fails on 65.5% of the tasks. Our analysis reveals a universal "execution bottleneck": both code and language models struggle to faithfully execute plans, even when provided with correct strategies. Specifically, code-based methods prove brittle on raw scientific tables, while natural language reasoning primarily fails due to initial comprehension issues and calculation errors.

AI.tldr: SciTaRC是一个专家编写的科学论文表格数据问答基准，要求深度语言推理和复杂计算，当前最先进的AI模型在至少23%的问题上失败，即使是Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct这样的强大模型也有65.5%的失败率。
AI.motivation: 当前AI模型在处理科学论文中的表格数据时存在显著能力缺口，需要建立一个能够评估模型在深度语言推理和复杂计算方面能力的基准，以揭示现有模型的局限性。
AI.method: 创建SciTaRC基准，包含专家编写的关于科学论文表格数据的问题，这些问题需要深度语言推理和复杂计算。通过测试当前最先进的AI模型（包括代码模型和语言模型）在这些问题上的表现，分析其失败原因。
AI.result: 当前最先进的AI模型在SciTaRC基准上表现不佳：至少23%的问题失败，即使是强大的Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct模型也有65.5%的失败率。分析发现存在普遍的"执行瓶颈"：代码模型在原始科学表格上表现脆弱，而自然语言推理模型主要因初始理解问题和计算错误而失败。
AI.conclusion: AI模型在处理科学论文表格数据时面临重大挑战，特别是在执行复杂计算和深度语言推理方面。代码模型和语言模型都存在执行瓶颈，这为未来改进模型在科学数据分析方面的能力指明了方向。

title: Interpretable Markov-Based Spatiotemporal Risk Surfaces for Missing-Child Search Planning with Reinforcement Learning and LLM-Based Quality Assurance
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at ICEIS 2026 (International Conference on Enterprise Information Systems)
summary: The first 72 hours of a missing-child investigation are critical for successful recovery. However, law enforcement agencies often face fragmented, unstructured data and a lack of dynamic, geospatial predictive tools. Our system, Guardian, provides an end-to-end decision-support system for missing-child investigation and early search planning. It converts heterogeneous, unstructured case documents into a schema-aligned spatiotemporal representation, enriches cases with geocoding and transportation context, and provides probabilistic search products spanning 0-72 hours. In this paper, we present an overview of Guardian as well as a detailed description of a three-layer predictive component of the system. The first layer is a Markov chain, a sparse, interpretable model with transitions incorporating road accessibility costs, seclusion preferences, and corridor bias with separate day/night parameterizations. The Markov chain's output prediction distributions are then transformed into operationally useful search plans by the second layer's reinforcement learning. Finally, the third layer's LLM performs post hoc validation of layer 2 search plans prior to their release. Using a synthetic but realistic case study, we report quantitative outputs across 24/48/72-hour horizons and analyze sensitivity, failure modes, and tradeoffs. Results show that the proposed predictive system with the three-layer architecture produces interpretable priors for zone optimization and human review.

AI.tldr: Guardian系统为失踪儿童调查提供端到端决策支持，通过三层预测架构（马尔可夫链、强化学习、LLM验证）生成可解释的搜索计划，在0-72小时关键窗口内提高搜救成功率。
AI.motivation: 失踪儿童调查的前72小时至关重要，但执法机构面临数据碎片化、非结构化以及缺乏动态地理空间预测工具的挑战。需要系统化的决策支持工具来提高搜救效率。
AI.method: 1. 将异构非结构化案件文档转换为时空表示，并加入地理编码和交通上下文；2. 三层预测架构：第一层马尔可夫链模型（考虑道路可达性、隐蔽偏好、走廊偏差等）；第二层强化学习将预测分布转化为可操作的搜索计划；第三层LLM进行事后验证。
AI.result: 使用合成但真实的案例研究，在24/48/72小时时间范围内报告定量输出，分析敏感性、失败模式和权衡。结果显示三层预测架构为区域优化和人工审查提供了可解释的先验概率。
AI.conclusion: Guardian系统通过三层预测架构为失踪儿童调查提供有效的决策支持，在关键72小时内生成可解释的搜索计划，有助于提高搜救成功率。

title: Towards Visual Query Segmentation in the Wild
summary: In this paper, we introduce visual query segmentation (VQS), a new paradigm of visual query localization (VQL) that aims to segment all pixel-level occurrences of an object of interest in an untrimmed video, given an external visual query. Compared to existing VQL locating only the last appearance of a target using bounding boxes, VQS enables more comprehensive (i.e., all object occurrences) and precise (i.e., pixel-level masks) localization, making it more practical for real-world scenarios. To foster research on this task, we present VQS-4K, a large-scale benchmark dedicated to VQS. Specifically, VQS-4K contains 4,111 videos with more than 1.3 million frames and covers a diverse set of 222 object categories. Each video is paired with a visual query defined by a frame outside the search video and its target mask, and annotated with spatial-temporal masklets corresponding to the queried target. To ensure high quality, all videos in VQS-4K are manually labeled with meticulous inspection and iterative refinement. To the best of our knowledge, VQS-4K is the first benchmark specifically designed for VQS. Furthermore, to stimulate future research, we present a simple yet effective method, named VQ-SAM, which extends SAM 2 by leveraging target-specific and background distractor cues from the video to progressively evolve the memory through a novel multi-stage framework with an adaptive memory generation (AMG) module for VQS, significantly improving the performance. In our extensive experiments on VQS-4K, VQ-SAM achieves promising results and surpasses all existing approaches, demonstrating its effectiveness. With the proposed VQS-4K and VQ-SAM, we expect to go beyond the current VQL paradigm and inspire more future research and practical applications on VQS. Our benchmark, code, and results will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉查询分割(VQS)新范式，旨在通过外部视觉查询分割未修剪视频中目标对象的所有像素级出现，相比现有视觉查询定位方法更全面精确，并构建了首个VQS专用基准VQS-4K和有效方法VQ-SAM。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉查询定位(VQL)方法仅用边界框定位目标的最后出现，存在局限性。需要更全面（所有对象出现）和精确（像素级掩码）的定位方法，以适应实际应用场景。
AI.method: 1) 提出VQS-4K基准：包含4,111个视频、130万帧、222个对象类别，每个视频配有外部视觉查询帧和目标掩码，标注时空掩码片段；2) 提出VQ-SAM方法：扩展SAM 2，利用视频中的目标特定和背景干扰线索，通过多阶段框架和自适应内存生成(AMG)模块逐步演化内存。
AI.result: VQ-SAM在VQS-4K基准上取得有希望的结果，超越所有现有方法，证明了其有效性。VQS-4K是首个专门为VQS设计的基准。
AI.conclusion: 提出的VQS-4K基准和VQ-SAM方法超越了当前VQL范式，有望激发更多VQS的未来研究和实际应用。基准、代码和结果将公开提供。

title: AgentOS: From Application Silos to a Natural Language-Driven Data Ecosystem
summary: The rapid emergence of open-source, locally hosted intelligent agents marks a critical inflection point in human-computer interaction. Systems such as OpenClaw demonstrate that Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents can autonomously operate local computing environments, orchestrate workflows, and integrate external tools. However, within the current paradigm, these agents remain conventional applications running on legacy operating systems originally designed for Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) or Command Line Interfaces (CLIs). This architectural mismatch leads to fragmented interaction models, poorly structured permission management (often described as "Shadow AI"), and severe context fragmentation. This paper proposes a new paradigm: a Personal Agent Operating System (AgentOS). In AgentOS, traditional GUI desktops are replaced by a Natural User Interface (NUI) centered on a unified natural language or voice portal. The system core becomes an Agent Kernel that interprets user intent, decomposes tasks, and coordinates multiple agents, while traditional applications evolve into modular Skills-as-Modules enabling users to compose software through natural language rules. We argue that realizing AgentOS fundamentally becomes a Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD) problem. The Agent Kernel must operate as a real-time engine for intent mining and knowledge discovery. Viewed through this lens, the operating system becomes a continuous data mining pipeline involving sequential pattern mining for workflow automation, recommender systems for skill retrieval, and dynamically evolving personal knowledge graphs. These challenges define a new research agenda for the KDD community in building the next generation of intelligent computing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出个人智能体操作系统（AgentOS）新范式，用自然用户界面替代传统GUI桌面，以智能体内核为核心协调多个智能体，将传统应用转化为模块化技能，将操作系统构建问题转化为知识发现与数据挖掘问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的智能体（如OpenClaw）虽然能自主操作本地计算环境，但仍运行在为GUI/CLI设计的传统操作系统上，导致交互模型碎片化、权限管理混乱（"影子AI"）和严重的上下文碎片化问题。
AI.method: 提出AgentOS架构：1）用自然语言/语音门户为中心的自然用户界面替代传统GUI桌面；2）智能体内核负责解释用户意图、分解任务、协调多个智能体；3）传统应用演变为模块化技能，用户可通过自然语言规则组合软件；4）将操作系统构建视为KDD问题，智能体内核作为实时意图挖掘和知识发现引擎。
AI.result: 将操作系统重新定义为连续的数据挖掘管道，涉及工作流自动化的序列模式挖掘、技能检索的推荐系统以及动态演化的个人知识图谱，为KDD社区定义了构建下一代智能计算系统的新研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 实现AgentOS从根本上成为知识发现与数据挖掘问题，需要KDD社区研究意图挖掘、知识发现、序列模式挖掘、推荐系统和动态知识图谱等技术，以构建下一代智能计算系统。

title: Learning When to Sample: Confidence-Aware Self-Consistency for Efficient LLM Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance through chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, yet often generate unnecessarily long reasoning paths that incur high inference cost. Recent self-consistency-based approaches further improve accuracy but require sampling and aggregating multiple reasoning trajectories, leading to substantial additional computational overhead. This paper introduces a confidence-aware decision framework that analyzes a single completed reasoning trajectory to adaptively select between single-path and multi-path reasoning. The framework is trained using sentence-level numeric and linguistic features extracted from intermediate reasoning states in the MedQA dataset and generalizes effectively to MathQA, MedMCQA, and MMLU without additional fine-tuning. Experimental results show that the proposed method maintains accuracy comparable to multi-path baselines while using up to 80\% fewer tokens. These findings demonstrate that reasoning trajectories contain rich signals for uncertainty estimation, enabling a simple, transferable mechanism to balance accuracy and efficiency in LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出基于置信度的自适应决策框架，通过分析单条推理轨迹在保持多路径推理准确性的同时减少80%计算开销
AI.motivation: 现有链式思维推理方法生成过长推理路径导致高推理成本，而自一致性方法需要采样多条轨迹带来额外计算开销，需要平衡准确性和效率
AI.method: 提出置信感知决策框架，分析单条完整推理轨迹，使用从MedQA中间推理状态提取的句子级数值和语言特征训练，自适应选择单路径或多路径推理
AI.result: 在MathQA、MedMCQA和MMLU数据集上无需微调即可有效泛化，保持与多路径基线相当的准确性，同时减少高达80%的token使用
AI.conclusion: 推理轨迹包含丰富的置信度估计信号，能够通过简单可迁移的机制平衡LLM推理的准确性和效率

title: A Consensus-Driven Multi-LLM Pipeline for Missing-Person Investigations
comment: Accepted to CAC: Applied Computing & Automation Conferences 2026. 16 pages, 6 figures
summary: The first 72 hours of a missing-person investigation are critical for successful recovery. Guardian is an end-to-end system designed to support missing-child investigation and early search planning. This paper presents the Guardian LLM Pipeline, a multi-model system in which LLMs are used for intelligent information extraction and processing related to missing-person search operations. The pipeline coordinates end-to-end execution across task-specialized LLM models and invokes a consensus LLM engine that compares multiple model outputs and resolves disagreements. The pipeline is further strengthened by QLoRA-based fine-tuning, using curated datasets. The presented design aligns with prior work on weak supervision and LLM-assisted annotation, emphasizing conservative, auditable use of LLMs as structured extractors and labelers rather than unconstrained end-to-end decision makers.

AI.tldr: Guardian是一个端到端系统，使用多模型LLM管道支持失踪儿童调查和早期搜索规划，通过共识机制和QLoRA微调提高信息提取的准确性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 失踪人员调查的前72小时对成功找回至关重要，需要智能系统支持早期搜索规划。现有方法缺乏有效的端到端信息处理能力，需要开发能够保守、可审计地使用LLM的系统。
AI.method: 设计了一个多模型LLM管道，使用任务专用LLM模型进行智能信息提取和处理，通过共识LLM引擎比较多个模型输出并解决分歧，采用QLoRA微调使用策划的数据集进行强化。
AI.result: 开发了Guardian LLM管道系统，能够协调端到端执行，提供结构化信息提取和标注功能，与弱监督和LLM辅助标注的先前工作保持一致。
AI.conclusion: Guardian系统将LLM作为结构化提取器和标注器而非无约束的端到端决策者，强调保守、可审计的使用方式，为失踪儿童调查提供了有效的技术支持。

title: Reading, Not Thinking: Understanding and Bridging the Modality Gap When Text Becomes Pixels in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can process text presented as images, yet they often perform worse than when the same content is provided as textual tokens. We systematically diagnose this "modality gap" by evaluating seven MLLMs across seven benchmarks in five input modes, spanning both synthetically rendered text and realistic document images from arXiv PDFs to Wikipedia pages. We find that the modality gap is task- and data-dependent. For example, math tasks degrade by over 60 points on synthetic renderings, while natural document images often match or exceed text-mode performance. Rendering choices such as font and resolution are strong confounds, with font alone swinging accuracy by up to 47 percentage points. To understand this, we conduct a grounded-theory error analysis of over 4,000 examples, revealing that image mode selectively amplifies reading errors (calculation and formatting failures) while leaving knowledge and reasoning errors largely unchanged, and that some models exhibit a chain-of-thought reasoning collapse under visual input. Motivated by these findings, we propose a self-distillation method that trains the model on its own pure text reasoning traces paired with image inputs, raising image-mode accuracy on GSM8K from 30.71% to 92.72% and transferring to unseen benchmarks without catastrophic forgetting. Overall, our study provides a systematic understanding of the modality gap and suggests a practical path toward improving visual text understanding in multimodal language models.

AI.tldr: 论文系统诊断了多模态大语言模型在处理图像文本时出现的"模态鸿沟"问题，发现任务和数据依赖性，并提出自蒸馏方法显著提升性能
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型能够处理以图像形式呈现的文本，但通常比相同内容以文本标记形式提供时表现更差。这种"模态鸿沟"需要系统诊断和理解。
AI.method: 在7个基准测试中评估7个MLLM模型，涵盖5种输入模式，包括合成渲染文本和真实文档图像。进行超过4000个样本的扎根理论错误分析，并提出自蒸馏方法训练模型使用自己的纯文本推理轨迹与图像输入配对。
AI.result: 模态鸿沟具有任务和数据依赖性：数学任务在合成渲染上下降超过60分，而自然文档图像通常匹配或超过文本模式性能。渲染选择如字体和分辨率是强混淆因素，仅字体就能使准确率波动高达47个百分点。自蒸馏方法将GSM8K上的图像模式准确率从30.71%提升到92.72%，并能迁移到未见过的基准测试而不发生灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了对模态鸿沟的系统理解，并提出了一条改善多模态语言模型中视觉文本理解的实用路径。图像模式选择性地放大了阅读错误，而知识和推理错误基本保持不变，某些模型在视觉输入下表现出思维链推理崩溃。

title: The FABRIC Strategy for Verifying Neural Feedback Systems
summary: Forward reachability analysis is a dominant approach for verifying reach-avoid specifications in neural feedback systems, i.e., dynamical systems controlled by neural networks, and a number of directions have been proposed and studied. In contrast, far less attention has been given to backward reachability analysis for these systems, in part because of the limited scalability of known techniques. In this work, we begin to address this gap by introducing new algorithms for computing both over- and underapproximations of backward reachable sets for nonlinear neural feedback systems. We also describe and implement an integration of these backward reachability techniques with existing ones for forward analysis. We call the resulting algorithm Forward and Backward Reachability Integration for Certification (FaBRIC). We evaluate our algorithms on a representative set of benchmarks and show that they significantly outperform the prior state of the art.

AI.tldr: FaBRIC算法通过整合前向和后向可达性分析，显著提升了神经反馈系统验证性能
AI.motivation: 神经反馈系统的后向可达性分析研究较少，现有技术可扩展性有限，需要开发更高效的后向可达性分析算法
AI.method: 提出计算非线性神经反馈系统后向可达集的上近似和下近似的新算法，并将这些后向可达性技术与现有前向分析技术整合，形成FaBRIC算法
AI.result: 在代表性基准测试中，新算法显著优于现有技术水平
AI.conclusion: FaBRIC算法通过整合前向和后向可达性分析，为神经反馈系统的验证提供了更有效的解决方案

title: MEGC2026: Micro-Expression Grand Challenge on Visual Question Answering
summary: Facial micro-expressions (MEs) are involuntary movements of the face that occur spontaneously when a person experiences an emotion but attempts to suppress or repress the facial expression, typically found in a high-stakes environment. In recent years, substantial advancements have been made in the areas of ME recognition, spotting, and generation. The emergence of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and large vision-language models (LVLMs) offers promising new avenues for enhancing ME analysis through their powerful multimodal reasoning capabilities. The ME grand challenge (MEGC) 2026 introduces two tasks that reflect these evolving research directions: (1) ME video question answering (ME-VQA), which explores ME understanding through visual question answering on relatively short video sequences, leveraging MLLMs or LVLMs to address diverse question types related to MEs; and (2) ME long-video question answering (ME-LVQA), which extends VQA to long-duration video sequences in realistic settings, requiring models to handle temporal reasoning and subtle micro-expression detection across extended time periods. All participating algorithms are required to submit their results on a public leaderboard. More details are available at https://megc2026.github.io.

AI.tldr: MEGC 2026挑战赛引入两个新任务：微表情视频问答和长视频问答，利用多模态大语言模型提升微表情分析能力
AI.motivation: 微表情分析在情感识别等领域有重要应用价值，但传统方法面临挑战。多模态大语言模型的出现为微表情分析提供了新的技术路径，需要探索其在微表情理解中的应用潜力
AI.method: MEGC 2026提出两个任务：1) ME-VQA：在短视频序列上进行视觉问答，利用MLLMs/LVLMs处理多种微表情相关问题；2) ME-LVQA：扩展到长时视频序列，要求模型具备时间推理和跨时段的微表情检测能力
AI.result: 论文介绍了MEGC 2026挑战赛的具体任务设计和评估框架，为微表情分析领域提供了新的研究方向和技术基准，参赛算法需要在公开排行榜上提交结果
AI.conclusion: 多模态大语言模型为微表情分析带来了新的机遇，MEGC 2026的两个任务将推动该领域向更智能、更实用的方向发展，促进微表情理解技术的进步

title: Bioalignment: Measuring and Improving LLM Disposition Toward Biological Systems for AI Safety
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained on internet-scale corpora can exhibit systematic biases that increase the probability of unwanted behavior. In this study, we examined potential biases towards synthetic vs. biological technological solutions across four domains (materials, energy, manufacturing, and algorithms). A sample of 5 frontier and 5 open-weight models were measured using 50 curated Bioalignment prompts with a Kelly criterion-inspired evaluation framework. According to this metric, most models were not bioaligned in that they exhibit biases in favor of synthetic (non-biological) solutions. We next examined if fine-tuning could increase the preferences of two open-weight models, Llama 3.2-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, for biological-based approaches. A curated corpus of ~22M tokens from 6,636 PMC articles emphasizing biological problem-solving was used first to fine-tune Llama 3B with a mixed corpus of continued training and instruction-formatted. This was then extended to Qwen 3B using instruction-formatted only. We found that QLoRA fine-tuning significantly increased the scoring of biological solutions for both models without degrading general capabilities (Holm-Bonferroni-corrected p < 0.001 and p < 0.01, respectively). This suggests that even a small amount of fine-tuning can change how models weigh the relative value of biological and bioinspired vs. synthetic approaches. Although this work focused on small open-weight LLMs, it may be extensible to much larger models and could be used to develop models that favor bio-based approaches. We release the benchmark, corpus, code, and adapter weights.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型存在偏向合成技术解决方案的系统性偏见，通过微调可以显著提升模型对生物解决方案的偏好，而不损害其通用能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在互联网规模语料训练中可能表现出系统性偏见，倾向于合成技术解决方案而非生物解决方案，这种偏见可能影响技术发展方向的选择。
AI.method: 使用50个精心设计的Bioalignment提示词，以Kelly准则启发式评估框架测量5个前沿模型和5个开源模型的偏见；然后使用约2200万token的PMC文章语料库对Llama 3B和Qwen 3B进行QLoRA微调，分别采用混合训练和纯指令格式两种方法。
AI.result: 大多数模型表现出偏向合成解决方案的偏见；QLoRA微调显著提高了两个开源模型对生物解决方案的评分（经Holm-Bonferroni校正后p<0.001和p<0.01），且未损害模型的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 即使少量微调也能改变模型对生物与合成方法的相对价值评估，这种方法可扩展到更大模型，用于开发偏向生物解决方案的模型，研究发布了基准、语料、代码和适配器权重。

title: TIDE: Text-Informed Dynamic Extrapolation with Step-Aware Temperature Control for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) faces challenges when generating images with higher resolution compared at training resolution, causing especially structural degradation due to attention dilution. Previous approaches attempt to mitigate this by sharpening attention distributions, but fail to preserve fine-grained semantic details and introduce obvious artifacts. In this work, we analyze the characteristics of DiTs and propose TIDE, a training-free text-to-image (T2I) extrapolation method that enables generation with arbitrary resolution and aspect ratio without additional sampling overhead. We identify the core factor for prompt information loss, and introduce a text anchoring mechanism to correct the imbalance between text and image tokens. To further eliminate artifacts, we design a dynamic temperature control mechanism that leverages the pattern of spectral progression in the diffusion process. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that TIDE delivers high-quality resolution extrapolation capability and integrates seamlessly with existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: TIDE是一种无需训练的文生图外推方法，解决了DiT在高分辨率生成时的注意力稀释问题，支持任意分辨率和宽高比生成，无需额外采样开销。
AI.motivation: 扩散变换器(DiT)在生成高于训练分辨率图像时面临挑战，特别是由于注意力稀释导致的结构退化。先前方法试图通过锐化注意力分布来缓解，但未能保留细粒度语义细节并引入明显伪影。
AI.method: 提出TIDE训练免费外推方法：1)识别提示信息丢失的核心因素，引入文本锚定机制纠正文本和图像令牌之间的不平衡；2)设计动态温度控制机制，利用扩散过程中的频谱进展模式消除伪影。
AI.result: 广泛评估表明，TIDE提供了高质量的分辨率外推能力，并能与现有最先进方法无缝集成。
AI.conclusion: TIDE有效解决了DiT在高分辨率生成时的结构退化问题，通过文本锚定和动态温度控制实现了无需训练的任意分辨率外推，保持了语义细节并消除了伪影。

title: MEMO: Memory-Augmented Model Context Optimization for Robust Multi-Turn Multi-Agent LLM Games
summary: Multi-turn, multi-agent LLM game evaluations often exhibit substantial run-to-run variance. In long-horizon interactions, small early deviations compound across turns and are amplified by multi-agent coupling. This biases win rate estimates and makes rankings unreliable across repeated tournaments. Prompt choice worsens this further by producing different effective policies. We address both instability and underperformance with MEMO (Memory-augmented MOdel context optimization), a self-play framework that optimizes inference-time context by coupling retention and exploration. Retention maintains a persistent memory bank that stores structured insights from self-play trajectories and injects them as priors during later play. Exploration runs tournament-style prompt evolution with uncertainty-aware selection via TrueSkill, and uses prioritized replay to revisit rare and decisive states. Across five text-based games, MEMO raises mean win rate from 25.1% to 49.5% for GPT-4o-mini and from 20.9% to 44.3% for Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, using $2,000$ self-play games per task. Run-to-run variance also drops, giving more stable rankings across prompt variations. These results suggest that multi-agent LLM game performance and robustness have substantial room for improvement through context optimization. MEMO achieves the largest gains in negotiation and imperfect-information games, while RL remains more effective in perfect-information settings.

AI.tldr: MEMO框架通过记忆增强的上下文优化，解决了多轮多智能体LLM游戏评估中的高方差问题，显著提升了胜率和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 多轮多智能体LLM游戏评估存在显著的运行间方差问题。在长时程交互中，早期的小偏差会通过多智能体耦合被放大和累积，导致胜率估计偏差和跨重复锦标赛的排名不可靠。提示选择进一步加剧了这一问题，因为不同的提示会产生不同的有效策略。
AI.method: MEMO（记忆增强的模型上下文优化）是一个自博弈框架，通过耦合保留和探索来优化推理时上下文。保留机制维护一个持久的记忆库，存储自博弈轨迹中的结构化见解，并在后续游戏中作为先验注入。探索机制运行锦标赛式提示演化，通过TrueSkill进行不确定性感知选择，并使用优先回放来重新访问罕见和决定性状态。
AI.result: 在五个基于文本的游戏中，MEMO将GPT-4o-mini的平均胜率从25.1%提升到49.5%，将Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct的平均胜率从20.9%提升到44.3%（每个任务使用2000个自博弈游戏）。运行间方差也显著降低，使得跨提示变体的排名更加稳定。在谈判和不完全信息游戏中获得最大提升，而在完全信息设置中RL仍然更有效。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体LLM游戏性能和鲁棒性通过上下文优化还有很大的提升空间。MEMO框架通过记忆增强和探索机制有效解决了评估不稳定和性能不足的问题，特别是在谈判和不完全信息游戏中表现出色。

title: Using Vision Language Foundation Models to Generate Plant Simulation Configurations via In-Context Learning
summary: This paper introduces a synthetic benchmark to evaluate the performance of vision language models (VLMs) in generating plant simulation configurations for digital twins. While functional-structural plant models (FSPMs) are useful tools for simulating biophysical processes in agricultural environments, their high complexity and low throughput create bottlenecks for deployment at scale. We propose a novel approach that leverages state-of-the-art open-source VLMs -- Gemma 3 and Qwen3-VL -- to directly generate simulation parameters in JSON format from drone-based remote sensing images. Using a synthetic cowpea plot dataset generated via the Helios 3D procedural plant generation library, we tested five in-context learning methods and evaluated the models across three categories: JSON integrity, geometric evaluations, and biophysical evaluations. Our results show that while VLMs can interpret structural metadata and estimate parameters like plant count and sun azimuth, they often exhibit performance degradation due to contextual bias or rely on dataset means when visual cues are insufficient. Validation on a real-world drone orthophoto dataset and an ablation study using a blind baseline further characterize the models' reasoning capabilities versus their reliance on contextual priors. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to utilize VLMs to generate structural JSON configurations for plant simulations, providing a scalable framework for reconstruction 3D plots for digital twin in agriculture.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个合成基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在生成数字孪生植物仿真配置方面的性能，利用Gemma 3和Qwen3-VL从无人机遥感图像直接生成JSON格式的仿真参数。
AI.motivation: 功能结构植物模型虽然能模拟农业环境中的生物物理过程，但其高复杂性和低吞吐量限制了大规模部署。需要一种可扩展的方法来生成植物仿真配置，以支持农业数字孪生应用。
AI.method: 使用Helios 3D程序化植物生成库创建合成豇豆地块数据集，采用五种上下文学习方法，利用开源视觉语言模型从无人机遥感图像生成JSON格式的仿真参数。通过JSON完整性、几何评估和生物物理评估三个类别进行评估。
AI.result: 视觉语言模型能够解释结构元数据并估计植物数量和太阳方位角等参数，但常因上下文偏见或视觉线索不足而依赖数据集平均值，导致性能下降。在真实世界无人机正射影像数据集上的验证和盲基线消融研究进一步揭示了模型的推理能力与对上下文先验的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个利用视觉语言模型生成植物仿真结构JSON配置的研究，为农业数字孪生中的3D地块重建提供了一个可扩展的框架，尽管模型在视觉线索不足时仍依赖上下文先验。

title: DEO: Training-Free Direct Embedding Optimization for Negation-Aware Retrieval
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have enabled diverse retrieval methods. However, existing retrieval methods often fail to accurately retrieve results for negation and exclusion queries. To address this limitation, prior approaches rely on embedding adaptation or fine-tuning, which introduce additional computational cost and deployment complexity. We propose Direct Embedding Optimization (DEO), a training-free method for negation-aware text and multimodal retrieval. DEO decomposes queries into positive and negative components and optimizes the query embedding with a contrastive objective. Without additional training data or model updates, DEO outperforms baselines on NegConstraint, with gains of +0.0738 nDCG@10 and +0.1028 MAP@100, while improving Recall@5 by +6\% over OpenAI CLIP in multimodal retrieval. These results demonstrate the practicality of DEO for negation- and exclusion-aware retrieval in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: DEO是一种无需训练的检索方法，专门解决否定和排除查询问题，通过分解查询为正负组件并优化嵌入，在文本和多模态检索中均优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有检索方法在处理否定和排除查询时效果不佳，而传统的嵌入适应或微调方法需要额外计算成本和部署复杂性。
AI.method: 提出Direct Embedding Optimization (DEO)，一种无需训练的方法，将查询分解为正负组件，并使用对比目标优化查询嵌入。
AI.result: DEO在NegConstraint数据集上优于基线方法，nDCG@10提升+0.0738，MAP@100提升+0.1028，在多模态检索中Recall@5比OpenAI CLIP提高+6%。
AI.conclusion: DEO证明了无需额外训练数据或模型更新即可实现否定和排除感知检索的实用性，适用于现实世界场景。

title: Time, Identity and Consciousness in Language Model Agents
comment: Accepted at AAAI 2026 Spring Symposium - Machine Consciousness: Integrating Theory, Technology, and Philosophy
summary: Machine consciousness evaluations mostly see behavior. For language model agents that behavior is language and tool use. That lets an agent say the right things about itself even when the constraints that should make those statements matter are not jointly present at decision time. We apply Stack Theory's temporal gap to scaffold trajectories. This separates ingredient-wise occurrence within an evaluation window from co-instantiation at a single objective step. We then instantiate Stack Theory's Arpeggio and Chord postulates on grounded identity statements. This yields two persistence scores that can be computed from instrumented scaffold traces. We connect these scores to five operational identity metrics and map common scaffolds into an identity morphospace that exposes predictable tradeoffs. The result is a conservative toolkit for identity evaluation. It separates talking like a stable self from being organized like one.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种评估机器意识的新方法，通过Stack Theory的时间间隙概念分离语言行为与内在组织，建立身份持久性评分系统
AI.motivation: 现有机器意识评估主要关注行为表现，特别是语言模型代理的语言和工具使用行为。但代理可以在评估中说正确的话，而实际上在决策时缺乏相应的约束机制。需要区分"说像稳定自我"与"组织像稳定自我"之间的差异。
AI.method: 应用Stack Theory的时间间隙概念来构建轨迹支架，将评估窗口内的成分出现与单一客观步骤中的共同实例化分离开来。实例化Stack Theory的Arpeggio和Chord假设于基于身份陈述，从工具化的支架轨迹中计算两个持久性评分，连接五个操作身份指标，并将常见支架映射到身份形态空间中。
AI.result: 开发了一个保守的身份评估工具包，能够分离"说像稳定自我"与"组织像稳定自我"之间的差异，暴露可预测的权衡关系，为机器意识评估提供了更精细的框架。
AI.conclusion: 通过Stack Theory的时间间隙和支架轨迹分析，建立了一种能够区分语言表现与内在组织结构的身份评估方法，为机器意识研究提供了更严谨的评估工具。

title: Emotion is Not Just a Label: Latent Emotional Factors in LLM Processing
summary: Large language models are routinely deployed on text that varies widely in emotional tone, yet their reasoning behavior is typically evaluated without accounting for emotion as a source of representational variation. Prior work has largely treated emotion as a prediction target, for example in sentiment analysis or emotion classification. In contrast, we study emotion as a latent factor that shapes how models attend to and reason over text. We analyze how emotional tone systematically alters attention geometry in transformer models, showing that metrics such as locality, center-of-mass distance, and entropy vary across emotions and correlate with downstream question-answering performance. To facilitate controlled study of these effects, we introduce Affect-Uniform ReAding QA (AURA-QA), a question-answering dataset with emotionally balanced, human-authored context passages. Finally, an emotional regularization framework is proposed that constrains emotion-conditioned representational drift during training. Experiments across multiple QA benchmarks demonstrate that this approach improves reading comprehension in both emotionally-varying and non-emotionally varying datasets, yielding consistent gains under distribution shift and in-domain improvements on several benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了情感如何影响大语言模型的注意力机制和推理过程，提出了情感平衡的问答数据集和情感正则化框架，以改善模型在不同情感文本上的阅读理解能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型经常处理情感各异的文本，但评估模型推理行为时通常不考虑情感作为表征变化的来源。以往研究主要将情感作为预测目标，而本研究关注情感作为潜在因素如何塑造模型对文本的注意力和推理过程。
AI.method: 1. 分析情感如何系统性地改变Transformer模型的注意力几何结构；2. 引入Affect-Uniform ReAding QA (AURA-QA)数据集，包含情感平衡的人工撰写上下文段落；3. 提出情感正则化框架，约束训练过程中的情感条件化表征漂移。
AI.result: 研究发现注意力几何指标（如局部性、质心距离、熵）在不同情感间存在差异，并与下游问答性能相关。情感正则化方法在多个问答基准测试中提高了阅读理解能力，在情感变化和非情感变化的数据集上都取得了改进，在分布偏移下获得了一致的增益。
AI.conclusion: 情感是影响语言模型注意力机制和推理性能的重要潜在因素。通过情感正则化方法约束情感条件化表征漂移，可以有效提升模型在不同情感文本上的阅读理解能力，为改进语言模型在情感丰富环境中的表现提供了新途径。

title: EPOCH: An Agentic Protocol for Multi-Round System Optimization
summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly used to improve prompts, code, and machine learning systems through iterative execution and feedback. Yet existing approaches are usually designed as task-specific optimization loops rather than as a unified protocol for establishing baselines and managing tracked multi-round self-improvement. We introduce EPOCH, an engineering protocol for multi-round system optimization in heterogeneous environments. EPOCH organizes optimization into two phases: baseline construction and iterative self-improvement. It further structures each round through role-constrained stages that separate planning, implementation, and evaluation, and standardizes execution through canonical command interfaces and round-level tracking. This design enables coordinated optimization across prompts, model configurations, code, and rule-based components while preserving stability, reproducibility, traceability, and integrity of evaluation. Empirical studies in various tasks illustrate the practicality of EPOCH for production-oriented autonomous improvement workflows.

AI.tldr: EPOCH是一个用于异构环境中多轮系统优化的工程协议，通过标准化角色、阶段和接口来协调自主代理对提示、代码和机器学习系统的迭代改进。
AI.motivation: 现有自主代理方法通常是针对特定任务设计的优化循环，缺乏统一的协议来建立基准和管理跟踪的多轮自我改进过程。
AI.method: EPOCH将优化组织为两个阶段：基准构建和迭代自我改进。每个轮次通过角色约束的阶段（规划、实施、评估）进行结构化，并通过规范命令接口和轮次级跟踪实现标准化执行。
AI.result: 该设计能够在保持评估稳定性、可重现性、可追溯性和完整性的同时，协调跨提示、模型配置、代码和基于规则组件的优化。
AI.conclusion: 在各种任务中的实证研究表明，EPOCH对于面向生产的自主改进工作流程具有实用性。

title: BiCLIP: Domain Canonicalization via Structured Geometric Transformation
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot capabilities, yet adapting these models to specialized domains remains a significant challenge. Building on recent theoretical insights suggesting that independently trained VLMs are related by a canonical transformation, we extend this understanding to the concept of domains. We hypothesize that image features across disparate domains are related by a canonicalized geometric transformation that can be recovered using a small set of anchors. Few-shot classification provides a natural setting for this alignment, as the limited labeled samples serve as the anchors required to estimate this transformation. Motivated by this hypothesis, we introduce BiCLIP, a framework that applies a targeted transformation to multimodal features to enhance cross-modal alignment. Our approach is characterized by its extreme simplicity and low parameter footprint. Extensive evaluations across 11 standard benchmarks, including EuroSAT, DTD, and FGVCAircraft, demonstrate that BiCLIP consistently achieves state-of-the-art results. Furthermore, we provide empirical verification of existing geometric findings by analyzing the orthogonality and angular distribution of the learned transformations, confirming that structured alignment is the key to robust domain adaptation. Code is available at https://github.com/QuantitativeImagingLaboratory/BilinearCLIP

AI.tldr: BiCLIP是一个通过几何变换对齐跨域视觉语言特征的框架，利用少量锚点样本实现领域自适应，在11个基准测试中达到SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型在零样本任务上表现出色，但将其适配到专业领域仍然面临挑战。基于理论发现——独立训练的VLMs之间存在规范变换关系，作者假设不同领域的图像特征可以通过规范化的几何变换相互关联，这种变换可以通过少量锚点样本恢复。
AI.method: 提出BiCLIP框架，对多模态特征应用目标变换以增强跨模态对齐。该方法极其简单且参数占用少，利用小样本分类中的有限标记样本作为锚点来估计领域间的几何变换。
AI.result: 在包括EuroSAT、DTD、FGVCAircraft在内的11个标准基准测试上进行了广泛评估，BiCLIP始终达到最先进的结果。通过分析学习变换的正交性和角度分布，为现有几何发现提供了实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 结构化对齐是鲁棒领域适应的关键。BiCLIP通过几何变换框架有效解决了视觉语言模型在专业领域的适配问题，证明了规范变换假设的有效性。

title: Can You Hear, Localize, and Segment Continually? An Exemplar-Free Continual Learning Benchmark for Audio-Visual Segmentation
summary:
Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) aims to produce pixel-level masks of sound producing objects in videos, by jointly learning from audio and visual signals. However, real-world environments are inherently dynamic, causing audio and visual distributions to evolve over time, which challenge existing AVS systems that assume static training settings. To address this gap, we introduce the first exemplar-free continual learning benchmark for Audio-Visual Segmentation, comprising four learning protocols across single-source and multi-source AVS datasets. We further propose a strong baseline, ATLAS, which uses audio-guided pre-fusion conditioning to modulate visual feature channels via projected audio context before cross-modal attention. Finally, we mitigate catastrophic forgetting by introducing Low-Rank Anchoring (LRA), which stabilizes adapted weights based on loss sensitivity. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance across diverse continual scenarios, establishing a foundation for lifelong audio-visual perception. Code is available at${}^{*}$\footnote{Paper under review} - \hyperlink{https://gitlab.com/viper-purdue/atlas}{https://gitlab.com/viper-purdue/atlas}
  \keywords{Continual Learning \and Audio-Visual Segmentation \and Multi-Modal Learning}

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个免示例的持续学习基准用于音频-视觉分割，并提出了ATLAS基线方法，通过音频引导预融合调节和低秩锚定技术来应对动态环境中的分布变化问题。
AI.motivation: 现实世界环境本质上是动态的，音频和视觉分布会随时间演变，而现有的音频-视觉分割系统假设静态训练设置，无法应对这种变化。需要解决这一差距，建立持续学习框架。
AI.method: 提出了ATLAS基线方法：1) 使用音频引导预融合调节，通过投影的音频上下文在跨模态注意力之前调节视觉特征通道；2) 引入低秩锚定技术，基于损失敏感性稳定适应权重，减轻灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在包含单源和多源音频-视觉分割数据集的四种学习协议上进行了广泛实验，展示了ATLAS在多样化持续学习场景中的竞争性能，为终身音频-视觉感知奠定了基础。
AI.conclusion: 建立了首个免示例的持续学习基准用于音频-视觉分割，提出的ATLAS方法通过音频引导预融合调节和低秩锚定技术，在动态环境中表现出色，为终身多模态感知系统的发展提供了基础。

title: LooComp: Leverage Leave-One-Out Strategy to Encoder-only Transformer for Efficient Query-aware Context Compression
summary: Efficient context compression is crucial for improving the accuracy and scalability of question answering. For the efficiency of Retrieval Augmented Generation, context should be delivered fast, compact, and precise to ensure clue sufficiency and budget-friendly LLM reader cost. We propose a margin-based framework for query-driven context pruning, which identifies sentences that are critical for answering a query by measuring changes in clue richness when they are omitted. The model is trained with a composite ranking loss that enforces large margins for critical sentences while keeping non-critical ones near neutral. Built on a lightweight encoder-only Transformer, our approach generally achieves strong exact-match and F1 scores with high-throughput inference and lower memory requirements than those of major baselines. In addition to efficiency, our method yields effective compression ratios without degrading answering performance, demonstrating its potential as a lightweight and practical alternative for retrieval-augmented tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出基于边际的查询驱动上下文剪枝框架，通过测量句子省略时线索丰富度的变化来识别关键句子，实现高效上下文压缩，在保持问答性能的同时提高推理效率和降低内存需求。
AI.motivation: 高效的上下文压缩对于提升问答准确性和可扩展性至关重要。在检索增强生成中，上下文需要快速、紧凑且精确地传递，以确保线索充分且大语言模型读取成本可控。
AI.method: 提出基于边际的查询驱动上下文剪枝框架，通过测量句子省略时线索丰富度的变化来识别关键句子。模型使用复合排序损失进行训练，强制关键句子具有较大边际，同时保持非关键句子接近中性。基于轻量级编码器Transformer构建。
AI.result: 该方法在保持高推理吞吐量和较低内存需求的同时，通常获得较强的精确匹配和F1分数。除了效率优势外，还能实现有效的压缩比而不降低问答性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法作为检索增强任务的轻量级实用替代方案具有潜力，能够在保持性能的同时实现高效的上下文压缩。

title: Chaotic Dynamics in Multi-LLM Deliberation
comment: Main text: 6 pages, 4 figures; Supplementary Information: 14 pages, 7 supplementary figures
summary: Collective AI systems increasingly rely on multi-LLM deliberation, but their stability under repeated execution remains poorly characterized. We model five-agent LLM committees as random dynamical systems and quantify inter-run sensitivity using an empirical Lyapunov exponent ($\hatλ$) derived from trajectory divergence in committee mean preferences. Across 12 policy scenarios, a factorial design at $T=0$ identifies two independent routes to instability: role differentiation in homogeneous committees and model heterogeneity in no-role committees. Critically, these effects appear even in the $T=0$ regime where practitioners often expect deterministic behavior. In the HL-01 benchmark, both routes produce elevated divergence ($\hatλ=0.0541$ and $0.0947$, respectively), while homogeneous no-role committees also remain in a positive-divergence regime ($\hatλ=0.0221$). The combined mixed+roles condition is less unstable than mixed+no-role ($\hatλ=0.0519$ vs $0.0947$), showing non-additive interaction. Mechanistically, Chair-role ablation reduces $\hatλ$ most strongly, and targeted protocol variants that shorten memory windows further attenuate divergence. These results support stability auditing as a core design requirement for multi-LLM governance systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究将5个LLM组成的委员会建模为随机动力系统，通过经验李雅普诺夫指数量化多轮执行中的稳定性，发现即使在T=0条件下也存在两种不稳定路径：同质委员会中的角色分化和无角色委员会中的模型异质性。
AI.motivation: 随着集体AI系统越来越依赖多LLM审议，这些系统在重复执行下的稳定性特征仍然不明确。研究旨在量化多LLM委员会在多次运行中的稳定性，特别是在实践中常被期望具有确定性行为的T=0条件下。
AI.method: 将5个LLM组成的委员会建模为随机动力系统，通过经验李雅普诺夫指数(λ̂)量化轨迹分歧。在12个政策场景中进行因子设计实验，分析同质/异质模型与有无角色分配对稳定性的影响。通过主席角色消融和缩短记忆窗口等机制分析来探究不稳定性的根源。
AI.result: 发现两种独立的不稳定路径：同质委员会中的角色分化和无角色委员会中的模型异质性。在HL-01基准测试中，两种路径都产生较高的分歧(λ̂=0.0541和0.0947)。混合+角色条件的稳定性优于混合+无角色条件(λ̂=0.0519 vs 0.0947)，显示非加性交互作用。主席角色消融对降低λ̂效果最显著，缩短记忆窗口也能进一步减少分歧。
AI.conclusion: 即使在T=0条件下，多LLM委员会也存在显著的不稳定性，这挑战了实践中对确定性行为的预期。稳定性审计应成为多LLM治理系统的核心设计要求，通过角色设计、模型选择和协议调整可以有效提高系统稳定性。

title: SVG-EAR: Parameter-Free Linear Compensation for Sparse Video Generation via Error-aware Routing
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a leading backbone for video generation, yet their quadratic attention cost remains a major bottleneck. Sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only a subset of attention blocks. However, prior methods often either drop the remaining blocks, which incurs information loss, or rely on learned predictors to approximate them, introducing training overhead and potential output distribution shifting. In this paper, we show that the missing contributions can be recovered without training: after semantic clustering, keys and values within each block exhibit strong similarity and can be well summarized by a small set of cluster centroids. Based on this observation, we introduce SVG-EAR, a parameter-free linear compensation branch that uses the centroid to approximate skipped blocks and recover their contributions. While centroid compensation is accurate for most blocks, it can fail on a small subset. Standard sparsification typically selects blocks by attention scores, which indicate where the model places its attention mass, but not where the approximation error would be largest. SVG-EAR therefore performs error-aware routing: a lightweight probe estimates the compensation error for each block, and we compute exactly the blocks with the highest error-to-cost ratio while compensating for skipped blocks. We provide theoretical guarantees that relate attention reconstruction error to clustering quality, and empirically show that SVG-EAR improves the quality-efficiency trade-off and increases throughput at the same generation fidelity on video diffusion tasks. Overall, SVG-EAR establishes a clear Pareto frontier over prior approaches, achieving up to 1.77$\times$ and 1.93$\times$ speedups while maintaining PSNRs of up to 29.759 and 31.043 on Wan2.2 and HunyuanVideo, respectively.

AI.tldr: SVG-EAR是一种用于视频扩散变换器的高效稀疏注意力方法，通过聚类中心补偿跳过块，并结合误差感知路由选择关键块精确计算，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: 扩散变换器在视频生成中表现出色，但其二次注意力计算成本成为主要瓶颈。现有稀疏注意力方法要么丢弃部分块导致信息损失，要么依赖学习预测器引入训练开销和输出分布偏移。
AI.method: 提出SVG-EAR方法：1）通过语义聚类发现块内键值相似性，使用聚类中心作为无参数线性补偿分支近似跳过块；2）引入误差感知路由，使用轻量级探针估计每个块的补偿误差，选择误差-成本比最高的块进行精确计算。
AI.result: SVG-EAR在视频扩散任务中改善了质量-效率权衡，在相同生成保真度下提高吞吐量。在Wan2.2和HunyuanVideo数据集上分别实现1.77倍和1.93倍加速，同时保持PSNR分别达到29.759和31.043。
AI.conclusion: SVG-EAR建立了优于先前方法的帕累托前沿，通过聚类中心补偿和误差感知路由，在无需训练的情况下有效恢复稀疏注意力中丢失的信息，显著提升扩散变换器的计算效率。

title: TaSR-RAG: Taxonomy-guided Structured Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) helps large language models (LLMs) answer knowledge-intensive and time-sensitive questions by conditioning generation on external evidence. However, most RAG systems still retrieve unstructured chunks and rely on one-shot generation, which often yields redundant context, low information density, and brittle multi-hop reasoning. While structured RAG pipelines can improve grounding, they typically require costly and error-prone graph construction or impose rigid entity-centric structures that do not align with the query's reasoning chain.
  We propose \textsc{TaSR-RAG}, a taxonomy-guided structured reasoning framework for evidence selection. We represent both queries and documents as relational triples, and constrain entity semantics with a lightweight two-level taxonomy to balance generalization and precision. Given a complex question, \textsc{TaSR-RAG} decomposes it into an ordered sequence of triple sub-queries with explicit latent variables, then performs step-wise evidence selection via hybrid triple matching that combines semantic similarity over raw triples with structural consistency over typed triples.
  By maintaining an explicit entity binding table across steps, \textsc{TaSR-RAG} resolves intermediate variables and reduces entity conflation without explicit graph construction or exhaustive search. Experiments on multiple multi-hop question answering benchmarks show that \textsc{TaSR-RAG} consistently outperforms strong RAG and structured-RAG baselines by up to 14\%, while producing clearer evidence attribution and more faithful reasoning traces.

AI.tldr: TaSR-RAG是一个基于分类指导的结构化推理框架，通过将查询和文档表示为关系三元组，并利用轻量级两级分类法约束实体语义，实现多跳推理中的逐步证据选择。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG系统检索非结构化文本块并依赖一次性生成，导致冗余上下文、信息密度低和多跳推理脆弱。结构化RAG管道虽然能改善基础，但通常需要昂贵的图构建或强加僵化的实体中心结构，与查询推理链不匹配。
AI.method: 将查询和文档表示为关系三元组，使用轻量级两级分类法约束实体语义。将复杂问题分解为有序的三元组子查询序列，通过混合三元组匹配（原始三元组的语义相似性和类型化三元组的结构一致性）进行逐步证据选择，并维护跨步骤的实体绑定表。
AI.result: 在多个多跳问答基准测试中，TaSR-RAG始终优于强大的RAG和结构化RAG基线，提升幅度高达14%，同时产生更清晰的证据归因和更忠实的推理轨迹。
AI.conclusion: TaSR-RAG通过分类指导的结构化推理框架，在不进行显式图构建或穷举搜索的情况下，有效解决了中间变量解析和实体混淆问题，提高了多跳推理的准确性和可解释性。

title: Deep Tabular Research via Continual Experience-Driven Execution
summary: Large language models often struggle with complex long-horizon analytical tasks over unstructured tables, which typically feature hierarchical and bidirectional headers and non-canonical layouts. We formalize this challenge as Deep Tabular Research (DTR), requiring multi-step reasoning over interdependent table regions. To address DTR, we propose a novel agentic framework that treats tabular reasoning as a closed-loop decision-making process. We carefully design a coupled query and table comprehension for path decision making and operational execution. Specifically, (i) DTR first constructs a hierarchical meta graph to capture bidirectional semantics, mapping natural language queries into an operation-level search space; (ii) To navigate this space, we introduce an expectation-aware selection policy that prioritizes high-utility execution paths; (iii) Crucially, historical execution outcomes are synthesized into a siamese structured memory, i.e., parameterized updates and abstracted texts, enabling continual refinement. Extensive experiments on challenging unstructured tabular benchmarks verify the effectiveness and highlight the necessity of separating strategic planning from low-level execution for long-horizon tabular reasoning.

AI.tldr: DTR框架通过分层元图、期望感知选择策略和孪生结构化记忆，解决大语言模型在复杂非结构化表格上的长时程推理问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在处理具有分层双向表头和非规范布局的复杂非结构化表格时，难以完成长时程分析任务，需要新的方法来解决这种深度表格研究挑战。
AI.method: 提出将表格推理视为闭环决策过程的智能体框架：1) 构建分层元图捕捉双向语义，将自然语言查询映射到操作级搜索空间；2) 引入期望感知选择策略优先选择高效用执行路径；3) 将历史执行结果合成孪生结构化记忆（参数化更新和抽象文本），实现持续优化。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的非结构化表格基准测试上的广泛实验验证了该方法的有效性，并强调了将战略规划与低级执行分离对于长时程表格推理的必要性。
AI.conclusion: DTR框架通过智能体方法成功解决了复杂非结构化表格上的深度推理问题，证明了将战略规划与执行分离的闭环决策过程对于长时程表格分析的重要性。

title: SkipGS: Post-Densification Backward Skipping for Efficient 3DGS Training
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves real-time novel-view synthesis by optimizing millions of anisotropic Gaussians, yet its training remains expensive, with the backward pass dominating runtime in the post-densification refinement phase. We observe substantial update redundancy in this phase: many sampled views have near-plateaued losses and provide diminishing gradient benefits, but standard training still runs full backpropagation. We propose SkipGS with a novel view-adaptive backward gating mechanism for efficient post-densification training. SkipGS always performs the forward pass to update per-view loss statistics, and selectively skips backward passes when the sampled view's loss is consistent with its recent per-view baseline, while enforcing a minimum backward budget for stable optimization. On Mip-NeRF 360, compared to 3DGS, SkipGS reduces end-to-end training time by 23.1%, driven by a 42.0% reduction in post-densification time, with comparable reconstruction quality. Because it only changes when to backpropagate -- without modifying the renderer, representation, or loss -- SkipGS is plug-and-play and compatible with other complementary efficiency strategies for additive speedups.

AI.tldr: SkipGS通过选择性跳过反向传播来加速3D高斯泼溅训练，在保持重建质量的同时减少23.1%的训练时间
AI.motivation: 3DGS在训练后期存在大量冗余更新：许多采样视图的损失已经趋于平稳，提供有限的梯度信息，但标准训练仍然执行完整的反向传播，导致训练效率低下
AI.method: 提出SkipGS方法，采用视图自适应反向门控机制：始终执行前向传播以更新每视图损失统计，当采样视图的损失与其最近基线一致时选择性跳过反向传播，同时强制最小反向预算以确保优化稳定性
AI.result: 在Mip-NeRF 360数据集上，相比3DGS，SkipGS减少23.1%的端到端训练时间，其中后期细化阶段时间减少42.0%，同时保持可比较的重建质量
AI.conclusion: SkipGS通过智能跳过冗余反向传播实现了高效的3DGS训练，由于只改变反向传播时机而不修改渲染器、表示或损失函数，具有即插即用特性，可与其他效率策略结合实现叠加加速

title: Quantifying and extending the coverage of spatial categorization data sets
summary: Variation in spatial categorization across languages is often studied by eliciting human labels for the relations depicted in a set of scenes known as the Topological Relations Picture Series (TRPS). We demonstrate that labels generated by large language models (LLMs) align relatively well with human labels, and show how LLM-generated labels can help to decide which scenes and languages to add to existing spatial data sets. To illustrate our approach we extend the TRPS by adding 42 new scenes, and show that this extension achieves better coverage of the space of possible scenes than two previous extensions of the TRPS. Our results provide a foundation for scaling towards spatial data sets with dozens of languages and hundreds of scenes.

AI.tldr: LLM生成的标签与人类空间关系标签高度一致，可用于指导空间数据集扩展，新增42个场景提升覆盖度
AI.motivation: 研究不同语言在空间分类上的差异，探索如何扩展现有空间数据集以更好地覆盖可能的场景空间
AI.method: 使用大型语言模型生成空间关系标签，与人类标签对比验证一致性，基于LLM指导选择新场景和语言，扩展TRPS数据集
AI.result: LLM生成的标签与人类标签高度一致，新增42个场景的扩展比之前两个扩展版本更好地覆盖了可能的场景空间
AI.conclusion: LLM可用于指导空间数据集的扩展，为构建包含数十种语言和数百个场景的大规模空间数据集奠定了基础

title: DataFactory: Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Advanced Table Question Answering
summary: Table Question Answering (TableQA) enables natural language interaction with structured tabular data. However, existing large language model (LLM) approaches face critical limitations: context length constraints that restrict data handling capabilities, hallucination issues that compromise answer reliability, and single-agent architectures that struggle with complex reasoning scenarios involving semantic relationships and multi-hop logic. This paper introduces DataFactory, a multi-agent framework that addresses these limitations through specialized team coordination and automated knowledge transformation. The framework comprises a Data Leader employing the ReAct paradigm for reasoning orchestration, together with dedicated Database and Knowledge Graph teams, enabling the systematic decomposition of complex queries into structured and relational reasoning tasks. We formalize automated data-to-knowledge graph transformation via the mapping function T:D x S x R -> G, and implement natural language-based consultation that - unlike fixed workflow multi-agent systems - enables flexible inter-agent deliberation and adaptive planning to improve coordination robustness. We also apply context engineering strategies that integrate historical patterns and domain knowledge to reduce hallucinations and improve query accuracy. Across TabFact, WikiTableQuestions, and FeTaQA, using eight LLMs from five providers, results show consistent gains. Our approach improves accuracy by 20.2% (TabFact) and 23.9% (WikiTQ) over baselines, with significant effects (Cohen's d > 1). Team coordination also outperforms single-team variants (+5.5% TabFact, +14.4% WikiTQ, +17.1% FeTaQA ROUGE-2). The framework offers design guidelines for multi-agent collaboration and a practical platform for enterprise data analysis through integrated structured querying and graph-based knowledge representation.

AI.tldr: DataFactory是一个多智能体框架，通过专门的团队协作和自动化知识转换来解决表格问答中的上下文限制、幻觉问题和单智能体架构不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型语言模型方法在表格问答中存在关键限制：上下文长度限制影响数据处理能力，幻觉问题损害答案可靠性，单智能体架构难以处理涉及语义关系和多跳逻辑的复杂推理场景。
AI.method: 提出DataFactory多智能体框架，包含采用ReAct范式进行推理编排的数据领导者，以及专门的数据库和知识图谱团队。通过映射函数T:D x S x R -> G实现自动化数据到知识图谱的转换，采用自然语言咨询实现灵活的智能体间协商和自适应规划，并应用上下文工程策略整合历史模式和领域知识。
AI.result: 在TabFact、WikiTableQuestions和FeTaQA数据集上，使用来自五个提供商的八个LLM进行测试，结果显示持续改进。准确率比基线提高20.2%（TabFact）和23.9%（WikiTQ），效应量显著（Cohen's d > 1）。团队协调也优于单团队变体（TabFact +5.5%，WikiTQ +14.4%，FeTaQA ROUGE-2 +17.1%）。
AI.conclusion: DataFactory框架为多智能体协作提供了设计指南，并通过集成的结构化查询和基于图的知识表示为企业数据分析提供了一个实用平台。

title: Reward Prediction with Factorized World States
summary: Agents must infer action outcomes and select actions that maximize a reward signal indicating how close the goal is to being reached. Supervised learning of reward models could introduce biases inherent to training data, limiting generalization to novel goals and environments. In this paper, we investigate whether well-defined world state representations alone can enable accurate reward prediction across domains. To address this, we introduce StateFactory, a factorized representation method that transforms unstructured observations into a hierarchical object-attribute structure using language models. This structured representation allows rewards to be estimated naturally as the semantic similarity between the current state and the goal state under hierarchical constraint. Overall, the compact representation structure induced by StateFactory enables strong reward generalization capabilities. We evaluate on RewardPrediction, a new benchmark dataset spanning five diverse domains and comprising 2,454 unique action-observation trajectories with step-wise ground-truth rewards. Our method shows promising zero-shot results against both VLWM-critic and LLM-as-a-Judge reward models, achieving 60% and 8% lower EPIC distance, respectively. Furthermore, this superior reward quality successfully translates into improved agent planning performance, yielding success rate gains of +21.64% on AlfWorld and +12.40% on ScienceWorld over reactive system-1 policies and enhancing system-2 agent planning. Project Page: https://statefactory.github.io

AI.tldr: StateFactory通过语言模型将非结构化观察转换为层次化对象-属性结构，利用语义相似性预测奖励，在跨领域任务中实现零样本奖励泛化，显著提升智能体规划性能。
AI.motivation: 传统监督学习的奖励模型容易受到训练数据偏差的影响，难以泛化到新目标和环境。研究者希望探索仅凭良好定义的世界状态表示是否就能实现跨领域的准确奖励预测。
AI.method: 提出StateFactory方法，使用语言模型将非结构化观察转换为因子化的层次化对象-属性结构表示。在这种结构化表示下，奖励可以自然地计算为当前状态与目标状态在层次约束下的语义相似度。
AI.result: 在包含5个不同领域、2454个独特动作-观察轨迹的RewardPrediction基准测试中，StateFactory相比VLWM-critic和LLM-as-a-Judge奖励模型分别降低了60%和8%的EPIC距离。在AlfWorld和ScienceWorld任务中，分别实现了+21.64%和+12.40%的成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: StateFactory诱导的紧凑表示结构赋予了强大的奖励泛化能力，不仅提高了奖励预测质量，还成功转化为改进的智能体规划性能，超越了反应式系统-1策略并增强了系统-2智能体规划。

title: Real-Time Trust Verification for Safe Agentic Actions using TrustBench
comment: Accepted at the AAAI 2026 Workshop on Trust and Control in Agentic AI (TrustAgent)
summary: As large language models evolve from conversational assistants to autonomous agents, ensuring trustworthiness requires a fundamental shift from post-hoc evaluation to real-time action verification. Current frameworks like AgentBench evaluate task completion, while TrustLLM and HELM assess output quality after generation. However, none of these prevent harmful actions during agent execution. We present TrustBench, a dual-mode framework that (1) benchmarks trust across multiple dimensions using both traditional metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations, and (2) provides a toolkit agents invoke before taking actions to verify safety and reliability. Unlike existing approaches, TrustBench intervenes at the critical decision point: after an agent formulates an action but before execution. Domain-specific plugins encode specialized safety requirements for healthcare, finance, and technical domains. Across multiple agentic tasks, TrustBench reduced harmful actions by 87%. Domain-specific plugins outperformed generic verification, achieving 35% greater harm reduction. With sub-200ms latency, TrustBench enables practical real-time trust verification for autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: TrustBench是一个双模式框架，既评估AI代理的信任度，又在执行前实时验证行动安全性，减少87%有害行动
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型从对话助手发展为自主代理，确保可信度需要从后验评估转向实时行动验证。现有框架如AgentBench评估任务完成度，TrustLLM和HELM评估生成后输出质量，但都无法在代理执行过程中防止有害行动。
AI.method: 提出TrustBench双模式框架：(1)使用传统指标和LLM-as-a-Judge评估多维度信任基准测试；(2)提供工具包让代理在执行行动前验证安全性和可靠性。框架在关键决策点介入：代理制定行动后但执行前。领域特定插件编码医疗、金融和技术领域的专门安全要求。
AI.result: 在多个代理任务中，TrustBench减少了87%的有害行动。领域特定插件比通用验证表现更好，实现了35%更大的伤害减少。延迟低于200毫秒，支持实用的实时信任验证。
AI.conclusion: TrustBench通过在执行前实时验证行动安全性，填补了现有评估框架的空白，为自主代理提供了实用的信任验证解决方案，特别是在领域特定场景中表现优异。

title: WS-Net: Weak-Signal Representation Learning and Gated Abundance Reconstruction for Hyperspectral Unmixing via State-Space and Weak Signal Attention Fusion
summary: Weak spectral responses in hyperspectral images are often obscured by dominant endmembers and sensor noise, resulting in inaccurate abundance estimation. This paper introduces WS-Net, a deep unmixing framework specifically designed to address weak-signal collapse through state-space modelling and Weak Signal Attention fusion. The network features a multi-resolution wavelet-fused encoder that captures both high-frequency discontinuities and smooth spectral variations with a hybrid backbone that integrates a Mamba state-space branch for efficient long-range dependency modelling. It also incorporates a Weak Signal Attention branch that selectively enhances low-similarity spectral cues. A learnable gating mechanism adaptively fuses both representations, while the decoder leverages KL-divergence-based regularisation to enforce separability between dominant and weak endmembers. Experiments on one simulated and two real datasets (synthetic dataset, Samson, and Apex) demonstrate consistent improvements over six state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to 55% and 63% reductions in RMSE and SAD, respectively. The framework maintains stable accuracy under low-SNR conditions, particularly for weak endmembers, establishing WS-Net as a robust and computationally efficient benchmark for weak-signal hyperspectral unmixing.

AI.tldr: WS-Net是一个专门用于高光谱图像弱信号解混的深度学习框架，通过状态空间建模和弱信号注意力融合解决弱信号崩溃问题，在模拟和真实数据集上相比现有方法显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像中的弱光谱响应通常被主要端元和传感器噪声所掩盖，导致丰度估计不准确。现有方法在处理弱信号时容易发生崩溃，需要专门针对弱信号解混的框架。
AI.method: 提出WS-Net框架，包含：1）多分辨率小波融合编码器捕捉高频不连续性和平滑光谱变化；2）混合主干集成Mamba状态空间分支用于高效长程依赖建模；3）弱信号注意力分支选择性增强低相似性光谱线索；4）可学习门控机制自适应融合两种表示；5）解码器利用KL散度正则化强制主导端元和弱端元之间的可分离性。
AI.result: 在一个模拟数据集和两个真实数据集（Samson和Apex）上的实验表明，相比六种最先进的基线方法，WS-Net在RMSE和SAD上分别实现了高达55%和63%的降低。该框架在低信噪比条件下保持稳定的准确性，特别是对于弱端元。
AI.conclusion: WS-Net为弱信号高光谱解混建立了一个鲁棒且计算高效的基准框架，通过状态空间建模和弱信号注意力融合有效解决了弱信号崩溃问题。

title: LLM as a Meta-Judge: Synthetic Data for NLP Evaluation Metric Validation
summary: Validating evaluation metrics for NLG typically relies on expensive and time-consuming human annotations, which predominantly exist only for English datasets. We propose \textit{LLM as a Meta-Judge}, a scalable framework that utilizes LLMs to generate synthetic evaluation datasets via controlled semantic degradation of real data, replacing human judgment. We validate our approach using \textit{meta-correlation}, measuring the alignment between metric rankings derived from synthetic data and those from standard human benchmarks. Experiments across Machine Translation, Question Answering, and Summarization demonstrate that synthetic validation serves as a reliable proxy for human judgment, achieving meta-correlations exceeding 0.9 in multilingual QA and proves to be a viable alternative where human judgments are unavailable or too expensive to obtain. Our code and data will become publicly available upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM作为元评判框架，通过语义降级生成合成评估数据集替代人工标注，验证其在多语言NLG任务中可作为可靠的人类评判替代方案
AI.motivation: 传统NLG评估指标验证依赖昂贵耗时的人工标注，且主要限于英语数据集，需要更可扩展的验证方法
AI.method: 提出LLM as a Meta-Judge框架，利用LLM通过对真实数据进行受控语义降级生成合成评估数据集，通过元相关性验证方法比较合成数据与人工基准的指标排名一致性
AI.result: 在机器翻译、问答和摘要任务中，合成验证可作为人类评判的可靠代理，多语言QA中元相关性超过0.9，证明在缺乏或昂贵的人工评判场景下是可行的替代方案
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的合成评估数据集为NLG指标验证提供了可扩展的解决方案，特别是在多语言和资源有限场景下，可作为人类评判的有效替代

title: Explainable Innovation Engine: Dual-Tree Agent-RAG with Methods-as-Nodes and Verifiable Write-Back
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves factual grounding, yet most systems rely on flat chunk retrieval and provide limited control over multi-step synthesis. We propose an Explainable Innovation Engine that upgrades the knowledge unit from text chunks to methods-as-nodes. The engine maintains a weighted method provenance tree for traceable derivations and a hierarchical clustering abstraction tree for efficient top-down navigation. At inference time, a strategy agent selects explicit synthesis operators (e.g., induction, deduction, analogy), composes new method nodes, and records an auditable trajectory. A verifier-scorer layer then prunes low-quality candidates and writes validated nodes back to support continual growth. Expert evaluation across six domains and multiple backbones shows consistent gains over a vanilla baseline, with the largest improvements on derivation-heavy settings, and ablations confirm the complementary roles of provenance backtracking and pruning. These results suggest a practical path toward controllable, explainable, and verifiable innovation in agentic RAG systems. Code is available at the project GitHub repository https://github.com/xiaolu-666113/Dual-Tree-Agent-RAG.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种可解释的创新引擎，将知识单元从文本块升级为方法节点，通过双树结构（方法溯源树和层次聚类抽象树）实现可追溯推导和高效导航，策略代理选择显式合成算子来组合新方法节点，验证器-评分层修剪低质量候选，支持持续增长。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）虽然改善了事实基础，但大多数系统依赖扁平化的块检索，对多步合成的控制有限。需要一种能够提供可追溯推导、可控合成和可验证创新的方法。
AI.method: 提出可解释创新引擎，将知识单元升级为方法节点。维护加权方法溯源树用于可追溯推导，层次聚类抽象树用于高效自上而下导航。推理时，策略代理选择显式合成算子（如归纳、演绎、类比），组合新方法节点并记录可审计轨迹。验证器-评分层修剪低质量候选并将验证节点写回支持持续增长。
AI.result: 在六个领域和多个骨干模型上的专家评估显示，相比基准方法有持续提升，在推导密集型设置中改进最大。消融实验证实了溯源回溯和修剪的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明了一条通向可控、可解释和可验证创新的实用路径，适用于智能RAG系统。代码已在GitHub仓库公开。

title: Spectral-Structured Diffusion for Single-Image Rain Removal
summary: Rain streaks manifest as directional and frequency-concentrated structures that overlap across multiple scales, making single-image rain removal particularly challenging. While diffusion-based restoration models provide a powerful framework for progressive denoising, standard spatial-domain diffusion does not explicitly account for such structured spectral characteristics. We introduce SpectralDiff, a spectral-structured diffusion-based framework tailored for single-image rain removal. Rather than redefining the diffusion formulation, our method incorporates structured spectral perturbations to guide the progressive suppression of multi-directional rain components.
